title: Decision-Making Delegation in Banks
eligible_reason: Stacked natural-disaster event design with a triple interaction, not a binary staggered TWFE. Code_Main.do builds event stacks (shock_id = group(yearmo stcntybr) of FEMA disaster declarations, lines 1089-1230), pools affected ('include') and control-county branches around each shock, and estimates reghdfe apy_mean include own c.include#c.own <allcon> <controls>, a(shock_id [yearmo#stcntybr] [yearmo#size_d]) clus(rssdid) on pre/post-collapsed branch-by-shock data, or dynamic versions with a(uninumbr#shock_id yearmo#shock_id). The coefficient of interest is include x own (affected county x branch sets rates locally), i.e. a DDD within stacks; most columns add branch, bank and county time-varying controls, and Table 11 uses ivreghdfe. Mortgage regressions (Table 7) follow the same stacked structure with treated x set2_deposit interactions. Excluded as a stacked design with additional treatment interactions and controls.
design_notes: Branch-month deposit rates (RateWatch, proprietary) 1997-2015; disasters from FEMA/SHELDUS; shock_id cohorts with L/F windows (post = L1_shock+L2_shock+L3_shock+shock). Table 2-3: cross-sectional determinants of local rate setting (reghdfe sd decentral2 ..., a(yearmo)). Tables 4-6: stacked DDD on apy_mean and ln_depsumbr. Table 7: cHMDA mortgage originations (05-09 mortgage_regs*.do) with a(shock_id ...) and matching variants. Table 8: hpi_growth. Table 11: ivreghdfe with instruments for own.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Many disaster shocks (stack cohorts), but the design is stacked with include x own interactions; no single binary absorbing treatment with unit and calendar-time FE.
data_files: Mortgage_Lending/chmda/chmda1998-2014.dta (confidential HMDA, MOCK; identical 32.8 MB files)
Data/sod_raw.dta, call.dta, fema.dta, msa_covariates.dta, hpi_msa.csv, etc. (public inputs, real)
data_files_note: Readme.pdf: 'We have prepared mock data for all confidential datasets. To replicate results, one would replace the mock data with the proprietary data.' The outcome variables (deposit rates, mortgage originations) come entirely from mock files.
software_notes: Stata (reghdfe, ivreghdfe, estout); Code_Main.do is about 4,800 lines.
priority_note: Stacked DDD; outcome data are mock.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text).
